notes: the chain is the fixed Ibadi shape: Abu Ubayda, Jabir b. Zayd, then the Companion; «سئل أسامة بن زيد» is passive, and the Companion is the one who answers and reports the Prophet's conduct, so he is the last link; the Prophet is not a link; HKG has a different first name and a gap that the text does not write

fixes.reason: HKG's route gives مسلم بن أيمن and a gap (موضع انقطاع) where the text writes أبو عبيدة and no gap.

evidence.quote: أبو عبيدة عن جابر بن زيد
